senses.gloss: (onomatop., v. preced.) [to hawk,] to laugh, (= צָחַק) to jest with, caress; to laugh at. Part. חָאִיךְ, חָיֵיךְ.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 26:8">Targ. Y. Gen. XXVI, 8</cite>.
Targ. Prov. XXIX, 9 חָאֵךְ, ed. Lag. חאיך (Lev. אָחֵיךְ Af.).—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:7">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לא בדידך קא חָיִיכְנָא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מְחַיַּיכְנָא</he>) I do not laugh at thee; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67">Gen. R. s. 67</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00935"><he>חָכַךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:25">Targ. Jud. XVI, 25</cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 18:12">Ib. XVIII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—Pesik. B’shall. p. 90ᵃ <he>אנא … ומְחַיֵּיךְ בהדין וכ׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>מדחיך</he>, Ms. Carm. <he>מגחך</he>) I will go and make sport of &c. (v. <cite ref="D00410"><he>דְּחֵיךְ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26b:1">Snh. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲחוּכֵי קא מְחַיְּיכַת בן</he> does thou make sport of us?—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:6">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>חייך</he> ed. (Ms. M. <cite ref="H00314"><he>אָחֵיךְ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 21:9">Targ. O. Gen. XXI, 9</cite>; a. e., v. supra.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:15">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מ״ט אֲחִיכַת</he> (Ms. M. <he>חייכת</he>) why didst thou laugh (with joy)? <cite ref="Berakhot 19b:11">Ib. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>לא תָחִיכוּ עלה</he> do not laugh at it (v. supra).—
